description: This file provides an API client for interacting with traffic endpoints, including functions to fetch live traffic data, historical data, and traffic predictions. It is intended for use in a React frontend application.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables or a fallback relative path.

methods.name: fetchLive(city = 'Bangalore')
methods.description: Fetches a live traffic snapshot for a specified city, with normalized data fields.

methods.name: fetchHistory({ city = 'Bangalore', format = 'points', from, to } = {})
methods.description: Fetches historical traffic data, defaulting to the last 60 minutes, in a format suitable for charts.

methods.name: fetchPredict({ city = 'Bangalore', horizonMinutes = 30 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches traffic predictions with a default horizon of 30 minutes.

ctags.name: fetchHistory
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchHistory({ city = 'Bangalore', format = 'points', from, to } = {}) {$/
